title: The Gigantic Turnip
sourceTitle: Родное слово для детей младшего возраста · Rodnoye slovo dlya detey mladshego vozrasta
note: A close English translation of Ushinsky’s compact public-domain Russian reading-book version of “Репка,” divided into five screen pages. The cumulative repetitions are retained; no story episode has been added.

rights.basis: The linked Russian National Electronic Library scan is the 1864 edition of Ushinsky’s reading book and is public domain by age. The displayed English translation was prepared for this collection.

artLabel: A family and their animals pull together on the leaves of an enormous turnip.
scenes: Grandfather planted a turnip. A very, very big turnip grew.

Grandfather began to pull the turnip from the ground. He pulled and pulled, but could not pull it out. He called Grandmother to help. Grandmother held Grandfather, Grandfather held the turnip. They pulled and pulled, but could not pull it out.

Grandmother called their granddaughter. The granddaughter held Grandmother, Grandmother held Grandfather, Grandfather held the turnip. They pulled and pulled, but could not pull it out. The granddaughter called the dog.

The dog held the granddaughter, the granddaughter held Grandmother, Grandmother held Grandfather, Grandfather held the turnip. They pulled and pulled, but could not pull it out. The dog called the cat; the cat called the mouse.

The mouse held the cat, the cat held the dog, the dog held the granddaughter, the granddaughter held Grandmother, Grandmother held Grandfather, Grandfather held the turnip. They pulled and pulled—and pulled out the turnip.

pageArt.alt: A Russian family, their dog, and their cat tug in a long line while the giant turnip only wiggles.
The turnip lies free as the whole family and their animals laugh together after their tumble.
